resources.string: Live WHOOP heart rate on your home screen

1. In the WHOOP app, open your device settings and turn on "Heart Rate Broadcast".
2. Grant Bluetooth and notification permissions when asked.
3. Tap "Start streaming", then add the PulseTile widgets to your home screen (long-press home screen → Widgets → PulseTile).

Note: while PulseTile is connected, your WHOOP can’t also broadcast to another device (Peloton, Zwift, etc.) at the same time.
Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by WHOOP.
Bluetooth permission is required to read your WHOOP heart-rate broadcast.
